runs.known_contention: Separate handgun checkout headless editor import began at 16:40:08 UTC; final A overlaps. Other host workloads/earlier build overlap are not isolated.

limitations: Initial release fixture omitted explicit extension preload; repaired before 25/25 release pass.
Outdated three-section assertion failed with legacy provider too; updated to exact four-section contract including location_baselines_v1.
Isolated integration harness omitted existing fullscreen policy and imported water texture; repaired before 82/82 release pass; setup-error leak retained in failed log.
One launch reported zero free space and did not start; recheck recovered without deleting files; underlying transient not diagnosed.
ABBA order completed after launch retry, but final A overlapped another checkout import. Whole-frame benefit/nonregression not established.
Pending 128 MiB cap bounds frozen copies only; worker reconstruction/encoding and serialized caches are additional memory.
Main capture remains O(resident data); total worker CPU efficiency and large-world delta/COW architecture remain open.
Short clean shutdowns are not long-session leak or multiplayer scale qualification.
Existing six water_cut_cells failures and legacy 81-cell interaction failure remain open.
